name: Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API
description: The Daraja API is a set of REST APIs enabling integration with M-Pesa, Kenya's leading mobile money platform by Safaricom. It supports STK Push (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online), C2B, B2C, B2B payments, transaction status queries, account balance checks, and reversal operations.
